newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products end firm amid China talk.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products end firm amid China talk.

text.p: Talk China this week may be seeking more soymeal and soybeans boosted the CBOT soy complex, including soyoil and soymeal, to a higher close, traders said.

There are strong indications China last week bought beans and meal and there was talk early Wednesday that China this week also may be seeking 300,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans for October/November shipment and 450,000 tonnes of Oct/Nov U.S. and South American soymeal, the traders said.
But U.S. exporters Wednesday downplayed the China talk and said the tonnage being sought this week was small.
Trading was slow before the release at 0730 CDT Friday of USDA's crop production and supply/demand reports.
Soyoil closed 0.04 to 0.14 cent per lb higher, with October up 0.14 at 23.55. Soymeal closed $0.40 to $1.50 per ton higher, with October up $0.90 at $248.80.
